scientific_estimand: Difference in downstream optimization performance between MolToken attribution-selected regions and strictly matched non-attribution control regions, restricted to the preregistered common-support cohort.

seed_handling.rule: Each matching seed is a repeated matched-control draw for the same fixed treated common-support cohort.
seed_handling.main_combined_analysis: Within each parent, retain all five seed-specific control results and average the seed-specific paired effect before population-level aggregation.
seed_handling.forbidden: Do not treat the 325 parent-seed rows or 460 region-pair rows as independent samples.

candidate_generation_scope.treated_regions: Only the frozen 92 common-support MolToken treated regions.
candidate_generation_scope.control_regions: Only the frozen seed-specific controls listed in the 460-row pair roster.
candidate_generation_scope.treated_generation_reuse: The treated region set is identical across all five seeds and may be generated once and reused.
candidate_generation_scope.control_generation: Generate the seed-specific matched control regions exactly as frozen; no control substitution.
candidate_generation_scope.edit_interface: same delete/replace/add builders for treated and control

downstream_evaluation_scope.candidate_pool_unit: For a given parent and seed, pool candidates only from that parent's frozen matched regions for the corresponding method.
downstream_evaluation_scope.shared_pipeline: Use the same frozen property prediction, filters, ranking, verifier gates, and final-slot selection for treated and control.
downstream_evaluation_scope.missing_final_slots: Remain in the B=5 denominator for binary hit-rate endpoints, following the frozen budget protocol.
downstream_evaluation_scope.metric_formulas: Use the already frozen downstream metric definitions; this scope lock does not redefine outcome formulas.

primary_inference.bootstrap_rule: Resample the 65 parents with replacement. When a parent is sampled, retain all five matching-seed control draws for that parent. Recompute the parent-level seed-averaged paired effect within every bootstrap replicate.

forbidden_after_outcome_observation: drop a seed because of outcome direction
retune candidate generation based on outcome
exclude parents based on optimization success
treat seeds as independent biological/statistical samples
interpretation_limit: Attribution-specific conclusions apply only to the strict common-support cohort of 92 treated regions in 65 parents. They must not be generalized numerically to all 178 treated regions or all 90 original parents.
full_pipeline_analysis_relationship: The original full MolToken pipeline analysis remains a separate descriptive performance analysis and is not the matched attribution-effect estimate.
